limits: Stage wall, row sum, cold setup and gates overlap: never sum all as total cost.
Aborted04 waste here covers persisted NLI row times and observed cold events only; missing interrupted startup/gate/I/O cost is not zero.
This addon covers PG/NLI/MiniCheck runtime files; Jev checkpoint/head latency remains in its separate frozen runtime/profile evidence.
Missing gate elapsed is UNKNOWN, not stage-wall minus row sum: residual includes startup/serialization/queue/I/O.
Cold setup can include CPU semantic sanity; weights/sanity separate only when explicitly measured.
Later collection without a cold event is NOT_MEASURED_IN_THIS_COLLECTION, not zero model cold cost.
RSS/Metal are process/device observed envelope; no per-model physical allocation or monetary cost inferred.
